activation_gate.required_state: fix merged and canary orchestration receipt verified

scheduler_policy.dependency_rule: A wave starts only after every dependency task is integrated and complete.
scheduler_policy.collision_rule: At most one task per ownership lane and no shared concrete target in one batch.
scheduler_policy.worker_rule: One bounded task packet, branch, worktree, commit, and evidence artifact per worker.
scheduler_policy.integration_rule: Workers never edit central task status; the integration writer regenerates it after verification.
scheduler_policy.failure_rule: Failed or blocked work checkpoints and exits without selecting a speculative dependent task.
scheduler_policy.release_rule: Release remains blocked until all checks, Cargo gates, UIAI evidence, acceptance tasks, and receipts pass.
